costumes.name: Moist Rabbit
costumes.description:
Folkwang costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: I'm always sweating up a storm. Not exactly the most convenient thing for an athlete...
Geez... It's sweltering out here... Coach, any chance I can hug you for a bit to cool down?
People like me who get hot easily should eat colder foods!

I have no choice, I have to win this without you!
Any chance you could slip me some additional supplements? Sigh, never mind.

The last time you snuggled up to me, it was so cozy...
Can we cuddle the whole day?
I'd like to train with you again so I can overcome the heat here. Oh, that's not how it works?
This heat is killing me! Where did Coach go...
You know the rules! If you don't show up soon, then you owe me 30 minutes of cuddling.

It's like a furnace in here, feels like I'm burning up!
Coach, I need you to cool me down.
I wish they'd really crank up the A/C in the gym.
I thought eating ice cream would help, but I haven't noticed any change.
Wow, you're like a human refrigerator! Can I... hold you for a while?
Will I not sweat as much now?
Is this some kind of new health care product?
Hopefully this will prevent me from heating up all the time...
Let... Let me wipe the sweat off my hands first! Thanks!
Oh great, I sweat even when I'm overjoyed!
Since you've given me a gift... how about a hug?
I wish I could hold you all the time, not just when I need to cool down.
Can you hug me tighter?
I like you so much! Really! Not even supplements can match you... I think?
Folkwang, reporting for duty!
Roger that!
I'll give it everything I've got!
I always sweat during a battle!
My hands are so sweaty, it feels like my gun is going to slip!
Whew... Here we go!
So... so hot...
So hot... This heat is killing me...
Oh no... My gun is slipping!
I should've eaten more ice cream to cool myself off...
Give me a look!
A/C, here I come!
H-O-T, hot!
So much sweat...
I've got to hold on just a little longer!
It's a real scorcher today!
Ow!
Ah...
Ugh...
I give up. I'm practically drowning in my own sweat.
I secured this victory with my blood, sweat, and... more sweat!
